reason: The hypothesis directly applies the well-known strategy of adding Al to reduce density and maintain strength, which is already demonstrated in Al-containing lightweight RHEAs (P6, P11, P12, P18, P26) and suggested for other systems (P5). It merely transfers this established approach to the HfMoTaTiZr alloy without a new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence, making it a straightforward extension of existing work.
